title: Luminaires - Particular Requirements: Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting
description: Specifies requirements for road and street lighting luminaires for use with electrical light sources on supply voltages not exceeding 1000 V. Covers mechanical strength, IP rating, thermal resistance, optical performance, and outdoor durability.
related_standards: IS 16102 (Part 1) : 2012 - Self-Ballasted LED Lamps Safety
IS 15885 (Part 2/Sec 13) - Controlgear for LED Modules
IS 16106 : 2012 - Electrical & Photometric Measurements of LED Light Sources
source_evidence: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) ETD 24 (Illuminating Engineering), Section 5.3 Clause 4.2

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Safety Requirements
description: Specifies the safety and interchangeability requirements, together with the test methods and conditions required to show compliance of self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services.
related_standards: IS 16102 (Part 2) : 2012 - Performance Requirements for Self-Ballasted LED Lamps
IS 16103 (Part 1) : 2012 - LED Modules for General Lighting
source_evidence: BIS ETD 24, Mandatory CRS (Compulsory Registration Scheme) under MeitY order

title: Lamp Controlgear - Particular Requirements for DC or AC Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
description: Specifies safety requirements for electronic controlgear (LED drivers) used with LED modules. Includes surge protection up to 4kV/10kV, power factor correction (>0.95), total harmonic distortion (THD < 10%), and thermal protection.
related_standards: IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 3) : 2012 - Street Lighting Luminaires
IS 16107 (Part 2/Sec 1) : 2012 - LED Luminaire Performance
source_evidence: BIS Electrotechnical Division, Quality Control Order (QCO) for LED Drivers

title: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Water Supply - Specification
description: Covers requirements for High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) pipes from 20 mm to 1000 mm nominal outer diameter intended for the conveyance of water for human consumption, industrial water supply, and irrigation.
related_standards: IS 7634 (Part 2) - Plastics pipes laying and jointing code of practice
IS 12235 - Methods of test for unplasticized PVC & PE pipes
source_evidence: BIS CED 50 (Plastic Piping Systems), Bureau of Indian Standards

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
description: Deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete. Covers design methods (Limit State and Working Stress), material specifications, M20 M30 M40 grades, mixing, placement, and durability standards for infrastructure projects.
related_standards: IS 1786 : 2008 - High Strength Deformed Steel Bars (TMT Bars)
IS 10262 : 2019 - Concrete Mix Proportioning Guidelines
IS 516 : 2021 - Hardened Concrete Testing
source_evidence: BIS Civil Engineering Division CED 2, Landmark Structural Indian Standard

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
description: Covers requirements of thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) steel bars, Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, and Fe 600 grades for use as reinforcement in concrete structures.
related_standards: IS 456 : 2000 - Plain and Reinforced Concrete Code of Practice
IS 2062 : 2011 - Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel
source_evidence: BIS MTD 4 (Wrought Steel Products), Mandatory QCO under Steel Ministry

title: Submersible Pumpsets for Clear, Cold, Fresh Water - Specification
description: Covers technical specifications, performance guarantees, efficiency thresholds, head capacity curves, and insulation classes (Class B/F) for submersible pumpsets used in tubewells, drinking water extraction, and agricultural irrigation.
related_standards: IS 9283 : 2013 - Motors for Submersible Pumpsets
IS 11346 : 2002 - Code of Practice for Selection and Installation of Agricultural Pumps
source_evidence: BIS MED 20 (Pumps and Turbines), Star Labeling requirement under BEE India

title: Mobile Phone Language Support - Requirements for Indian Language Support
description: Specifies mandatory input and display support for official Indian languages on mobile devices sold in India, including font rendering, keypads, and text prediction systems.
related_standards: IS 13252 (Part 1) : 2010 - Information Technology Equipment Safety
IS 16333 (Part 2) - Input Method Requirements for Mobile Handsets
source_evidence: BIS LITD 16 (Computer Hardware & Peripherals), Department of Telecommunications directive

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety: General Requirements
description: Applies to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including computer servers, laptops, desktop PCs, networking routers, printers, and display terminals.
related_standards: IS 16242 (Part 1) : 2014 - Uninterruptible Power Systems (UPS) Safety
IS 61000-4-2 - Electromagnetic Compatibility for IT Devices
source_evidence: BIS LITD 17, Mandatory registration scheme (MeitY compulsory certification)

title: Uninterruptible Power Systems (UPS) - General and Safety Requirements
description: Specifies safety and operational requirements for electronic power conversion systems (UPS) intended to supply AC power to critical IT equipment, data centers, and industrial loads.
related_standards: IS 16242 (Part 2) - Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) Requirements for UPS
IS 15549 - Stationary Valve Regulated Lead-Acid (VRLA) Batteries
source_evidence: BIS LITD 17 (UPS Systems Section), Bureau of Indian Standards

title: Uncoated Stress Relieved Low Relaxation Seven-Wire Strand for Prestressed Concrete - Specification
description: Specifies the technical requirements for low-relaxation 7-wire steel strands used in prestressed concrete structures, flyovers, metro rail elevated corridors, and highway bridges.
related_standards: IS 1786 : 2008 - Deformed Steel Bars for Concrete
IS 1343 : 2012 - Code of Practice for Prestressed Concrete
source_evidence: BIS MTD 4 (Steel Strand Division), Highway Ministry (MORTH) Specification

title: Automotive Vehicles - Child Restraints System - Specification
description: Specifies safety criteria, impact absorption testing, belt anchorages, and flame retardancy for child seats and restraint systems installed in motor vehicles.
related_standards: IS 15139 : 2002 - Automotive Safety Belts Specification
IS 15223 - Automotive Crash Safety Criteria
source_evidence: BIS TED 6 (Automotive Safety Division), CMVR Regulations

title: Cylinders for Domestic Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) - Specification
description: Specifies raw material selection, welded construction, hydro-testing (at 25 bar), burst testing, and safety valve fitting for 14.2 kg and 19 kg LPG cylinders for commercial and domestic distribution.
related_standards: IS 3196 (Part 1) - Welded Low Carbon Steel Gas Cylinders
IS 8737 - LPG Cylinder Valves Specification
source_evidence: BIS MED 16 (Gas Cylinders Division), PESO (Statutory Approval Body India)

title: Concrete Paving Blocks - Specification
description: Covers design requirements, water absorption (<6%), abrasion resistance, and characteristic compressive strength for precast interlocking concrete paver blocks for urban roads, footpaths, parking lots, and industrial yards.
related_standards: IS 456 : 2000 - Code of Practice for Reinforced Concrete
IS 2185 (Part 1) - Concrete Masonry Units
source_evidence: BIS CED 53 (Precast Concrete Products), CPWD Specifications

title: Rubber Boots for General Purposes - Specification
description: Covers requirements for vulcanized rubber gumboots/gumboots used by workers in agricultural fields, sanitation, wet construction, and chemical handling environments.
related_standards: IS 15298 (Part 2) : 2016 - Personal Protective Equipment - Safety Footwear
IS 5676 - Industrial Safety Shoes
source_evidence: BIS CHD 19 (Footwear Section), Bureau of Indian Standards

title: Personal Protective Equipment - Part 2: Safety Footwear
description: Specifies basic and additional (optional) requirements for safety footwear used in general industrial workplaces, including 200 Joules steel toe cap impact resistance, slip resistance, and oil resistance.
related_standards: IS 15298 (Part 1) - Test Methods for Footwear
IS 2573 - Protective Leather Gloves
source_evidence: BIS CHD 19, Mandatory QCO by Ministry of Commerce and Industry

title: Code of Practice on Occupational Safety and Health Audit
description: Establishes audit procedures, methodology, checklist criteria, and reporting guidelines for evaluating occupational health, hazard identification, and safety management systems in factories, chemical plants, and construction sites.
related_standards: IS 18001 / ISO 45011 - Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems
IS 14490 - Guidelines for Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment
source_evidence: BIS CHD 8 (Chemical Hazards & Safety), Factories Act Guidelines

title: Medical Electrical Equipment - Pulse Oximeters for Medical Use
description: Specifies safety and accuracy requirements for finger pulse oximeters and bedside patient monitors measuring arterial oxygen saturation (SpO2) and pulse rate.
related_standards: IS 13450 (Part 1) - Medical Electrical Equipment Safety Requirements
IS 13450 (Part 2) - Particular Safety for Patient Monitoring Equipment
source_evidence: BIS MHD 10 (Electro-Medical Equipment), Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO)

title: Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Water Pumping Systems - Specification
description: Covers design, performance requirements, efficiency standards, solar panel array sizing, controller inverter specifications, and wire sizing for standalone solar powered water pump sets for agriculture and drinking water.
related_standards: IS 14286 - Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules
IS 16077 - Inverters for Use in Photovoltaic Power Systems
source_evidence: BIS ETD 28 (Solar Energy Division), Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)

title: Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
description: Specifies testing procedures (thermal cycling, damp heat, mechanical load, PID testing, hail impact) for terrestrial solar PV modules suitable for long-term outdoor operation.
related_standards: IS 61730 (Part 1 & 2) - Photovoltaic Module Safety Qualification
IS 16077 - Grid Connected Solar Inverters
source_evidence: BIS ETD 28, MNRE Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM)
